alerts.headline: Vog haze near Kaʻū from satellite
alerts.summary: On Oct 17, satellite image at 11:00 HST suggested vog from Kīlauea near Pāhala (Kaʻū), Nāʻālehu (Kaʻū), Ocean View (Kaʻū).

actions.text: Limit outdoor exertion when vog is high; exercise raises effects from gas and particles.
actions.excerpt_en: Limit strenuous activities: Outdoor exercise or exertion increases your chances of being affected by SO2 gas and/or PM2.5. When vog levels are elevated, reduce strenuous activity, if possible.

actions.text: When vog rose, go indoors, close doors and windows, and seal gaps if possible.
actions.excerpt_en: Stay indoors: When vog levels rise, go indoors and close all doors and windows to the outside and, if possible, seal obvious gaps under doors or around windows.

alerts.disclaimer: Satellite estimate, not an official warning.
alerts.disclaimer_en: Satellite estimate, not an official warning.

actions.text: Hạn chế vận động mạnh ngoài trời khi sương mù núi lửa (vog) dày đặc.
actions.excerpt_en: Limit strenuous activities: Outdoor exercise or exertion increases your chances of being affected by SO2 gas and/or PM2.5. When vog levels are elevated, reduce strenuous activity, if possible.

actions.text: Khi sương mù núi lửa (vog) tăng, hãy ở trong nhà, đóng cửa và bịt khe hở.
actions.excerpt_en: Stay indoors: When vog levels rise, go indoors and close all doors and windows to the outside and, if possible, seal obvious gaps under doors or around windows.

alerts.disclaimer: Ước tính từ vệ tinh, không phải cảnh báo chính thức.

actions.text: E kaupalena i ka hana ikaika ma waho ke piʻi ka vog.
